description: REA(역분석)를 써야 할 근거가 있는지 판정

target_type.instructions: What kind of product must be analyzed to answer the question?

criteria.website: A website or web app that can be observed in a browser
criteria.mobile_app: An Android or iOS app package
criteria.desktop_app: A desktop app such as Electron or .NET
criteria.none: No existing product needs to be analyzed

needs_internal.instructions: Can the question only be answered by inspecting the product's internal code or logic, because observing its screens, UI behavior, network requests, or public documentation would not be enough?
